description: Promoted to Frontend Team Lead within 2 years; mentored 6 engineers across 3 product lines.
Introduced a company-wide Frontend Guild for knowledge sharing and best practices.
Architected a Formik + Yup form framework, cutting form development time by 60%.
Designed and shipped a 100+ component UI library (compound pattern + Tailwind), improving developer onboarding speed and UI consistency across apps.
Optimized React performance, reducing re-renders by 98% under enterprise load.
Built a role-based access control (RBAC) system powering 500+ components.
Delivered real-time dashboards (WebSockets + GraphQL) enabling live device monitoring.
Increased test coverage by 40% with Jest, RTL, and Cypress; fostered a TDD culture.
Integrated multilingual support with react-i18next, scaling localization across apps.
Collaborated cross-functionally with product, design, and backend to align business goals with user needs.
Rebuilt the admin panel from scratch (React, Redux, SASS),  scored 95/100 on Lighthouse across all four categories
Reduced JS bundle by 45% via code splitting, tree shaking, and dynamic imports; load time dropped from 4.2s to under 1.5s.
Replaced prop-drilling with structured Redux,  QA UI bug rate dropped ~70%.
Added ESLint, Prettier, and component documentation; the in-house team owned the codebase post-handoff without issues.
Ramped to full output within a week,  the project hit its original 6-week deadline despite a mid-flight handoff.
Converted event listing pages to Next.js SSR,  Googlebot crawl coverage improved, TTFB dropped ~40% vs. prior SPA.
Delivered Figma-to-production components directly,  closed the design-to-code gap, driving the initial delays.
Integrated third-party payment gateway with session-based checkout; handled 10+ live event launches without incident.
